plugin.name: Aardwolf_Grid_Mapper
plugin.description: Alternative mapper visualization that uses an absolute grid system. Allows dragging rooms to change their positions.

alias.send: if "%1" == "in" then zoom_in() else zoom_out() end
load_known_rooms() draw_map() print("Grid Mapper: refreshed known rooms and redrew map")

local show = ("%1" == "show") GRID_WINDOW_VISIBLE = show SetVariable("window_visible", show and "1" or "0") if show then if not current_room then Send_GMCP_Packet("request room") end draw_map() WindowShow(GRID_WIN, true) else WindowShow(GRID_WIN, false) end

AUTO_CENTER = ("%1" == "on") SetVariable("auto_center", AUTO_CENTER and "1" or "0") if AUTO_CENTER then auto_center() draw_map() end print("Grid Mapper: Auto-center is now " .. (AUTO_CENTER and "ON" or "OFF"))

local val = tonumber("%1") if val and val >= 0.1 and val <= 1.0 then room_size_factor = val SetVariable("room_size_factor", val) draw_map() print("Grid Mapper: Room size factor set to " .. val .. " (Default: 0.6)") else print("Grid Mapper: Usage: gridmapper roomsize [0.1 to 1.0]") end

local win = GetPluginID() local f = utils.fontpicker(user_font_name, user_font_size) if f then user_font_name = f.name user_font_size = f.size SetVariable("user_font_name", user_font_name) SetVariable("user_font_size", tostring(user_font_size))
WindowFont(win, "f", user_font_name, user_font_size) WindowFont(win, "title", user_font_name, user_font_size + 1, true) auto_center() draw_map() OnPluginSaveState() -- Force save immediately print("Grid Mapper: Font set to " .. user_font_name .. " " .. user_font_size) end

ColourNote("gold", "", "Grid Mapper Help:") ColourNote("silver", "", " gridmapper show|hide - Toggle mapper window visibility") ColourNote("silver", "", " gridmapper autocenter on|off - Toggle auto-centering on movement") ColourNote("silver", "", " gridmapper center - Find and center on current room") ColourNote("silver", "", " gridmapper roomsize <0.1-1.0> - Set room size factor (default 0.5)") ColourNote("silver", "", " gridmapper font - Choose font name and size") ColourNote("silver", "", " gridmapper help - Show this help message") ColourNote("silver", "", " gridmapper shift <direction> - Move current/selected room(s) one grid unit (n/s/e/w/u/d)") ColourNote("silver", "", " gridmapper purgezone <area> - Remove stored grid positions for <area>") ColourNote("gray", "", " (Double-click or Alt-Click a room to speedwalk)") ColourNote("gray", "", " (Ctrl-Click a room to see info)") ColourNote("gray", "", " (Shift-Drag to select multiple rooms)")

local area = "%1" if not area or area == "" then print("Grid Mapper: Usage: gridmapper purgezone <area_uid>") return end
-- Ask for confirmation using utils.msgbox fallback local confirm = nil if utils and utils.msgbox then confirm = utils.msgbox("Are you sure you want to remove all stored grid positions for area '"..area.."'? This cannot be undone.", "Grid Mapper", "yesno", "?") if confirm == "yes" then confirm = true else confirm = false end elseif utils and utils.yesno then confirm = utils.yesno("Are you sure you want to remove all stored grid positions for area '"..area.."'? This cannot be undone.") else -- Last resort: prompt in the main window (no GUI) and assume no print("Grid Mapper: Confirmation unavailable. Aborting for safety.") return end if not confirm then print("Grid Mapper: Aborted.") return end
-- Ensure pos_db is available; try to open if plugin hasn't initialized it yet if not pos_db then local pos_path = get_db_path("Aardwolf_Grid.db") if not pos_path then print("Grid Mapper: Position DB path not found.") return end pos_db = sqlite3.open(pos_path) if not pos_db then print("Grid Mapper: Failed to open position DB at " .. tostring(pos_path)) return end end
-- Perform deletion local stmt = pos_db:prepare("DELETE FROM room_positions WHERE area = ?") if not stmt then print("Grid Mapper: Failed to prepare delete statement.") return end stmt:bind_values(area) stmt:step() stmt:finalize() pos_db:exec("VACUUM")
-- If we are currently viewing the area, remove in-memory entries if tostring(current_area) == area then room_positions = {} draw_map() end
print("Grid Mapper: Removed stored positions for area '"..area.."'.")

muclient.script:
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Library Imports -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local sqlite3 = require "sqlite3" local bit = require "bit" require "movewindow" -- Helper for saving window state/position
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Constants -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Mouse flags for input handling if miniwin doesn't provide them local LH_MOUSE = 0x10 local RH_MOUSE = 0x20 local SHIFT = 0x01 local CONTROL = 0x02 local ALT = 0x04 local DOUBLE_CLICK = 0x4000 require "copytable" require "tprint" require "gmcphelper"
-- Import Theme for consistent look require "mw_theme_base"
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Direction Constants -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- DIR_OFFSETS = { n = {x = 0, y = -1, z = 0}, s = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0}, e = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0}, w = {x = -1, y = 0, z = 0}, u = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1}, d = {x = 0, y = 0, z = -1}, ne = {x = 1, y = -1, z = 0}, nw = {x = -1, y = -1, z = 0}, se = {x = 1, y = 1, z = 0}, sw = {x = -1, y = 1, z = 0} }
REVERSE_DIRS = { n = "s", s = "n", e = "w", w = "e", u = "d", d = "u", ne = "sw", sw = "ne", nw = "se", se = "nw" }
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Global Variables & State -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- GRID_WIN = GetPluginID() local win = GRID_WIN
-- Database Handling pos_db = nil -- SQLite DB for saving custom room coordinates main_db = nil -- SQLite DB for reading Aardwolf world data
-- Game State current_room = nil current_area = nil current_area_name = nil -- Full text name of the area
-- Map Data rooms = {} -- Table of all room data in the current area room_positions = {} -- Table of {x,y,z} coordinates keyed by room UID area_rooms_cache = {} -- Per-area in-memory cache of rooms (to preserve runtime fields) area_positions_cache = {} -- Per-area in-memory cache of positions room_rects = {} -- Hit-test rectangles for mouse interaction pending_missing_attempts = {} -- retry counters for areas with missing room data pending_missing_rooms = {} -- map area_uid -> array of missing room uids
-- View Settings scale = tonumber(GetVariable("scale") or 30) or 30 offset_x = tonumber(GetVariable("offset_x") or 0) or 0 offset_y = tonumber(GetVariable("offset_y") or 0) or 0 room_size_factor = tonumber(GetVariable("room_size_factor") or 0.6) or 0.6 -- Font Settings (User Configurable) user_font_name = GetVariable("user_font_name") or "Dina" user_font_size = tonumber(GetVariable("user_font_size")) or 8
-- Caches and Lookups known_rooms = {} -- Global set of all known room UIDs (for coloring stubs) terrain_colours = {} -- Maps terrain name -> RGB color (from DB) user_terrain_colour = {} -- Maps terrain name -> RGB color (User overrides)
-- Default Color Palettes colour_lookup = { [0] = ColourNameToRGB "black", [1] = ColourNameToRGB "maroon", [2] = ColourNameToRGB "green", [3] = ColourNameToRGB "olive", [4] = ColourNameToRGB "navy", [5] = ColourNameToRGB "purple", [6] = ColourNameToRGB "teal", [7] = ColourNameToRGB "silver", [8] = ColourNameToRGB "gray", [9] = ColourNameToRGB "red", [10] = ColourNameToRGB "lime", [11] = ColourNameToRGB "yellow", [12] = ColourNameToRGB "blue", [13] = ColourNameToRGB "magenta", [14] = ColourNameToRGB "cyan", [15] = ColourNameToRGB "white", }
-- Special Room Colors (Overriding Terrain) SPECIAL_COLORS = { shop = ColourNameToRGB "#ffad2f", healer = ColourNameToRGB "#9acd32", guild = ColourNameToRGB "magenta", trainer = ColourNameToRGB "#9acd32", questor = ColourNameToRGB "deepskyblue", bank = ColourNameToRGB "#ffD700", safe = ColourNameToRGB "lightblue" } PK_COLOR = ColourNameToRGB "red" local dragging_room = nil local dragging_map = false local last_mouse_x = 0 local last_mouse_y = 0 local start_resize_x = 0 local start_resize_y = 0
selected_rooms = {} is_selecting = false selection_start_x, selection_start_y = 0, 0 selection_end_x, selection_end_y = 0, 0 local last_click_time = 0 local last_click_uid = nil hover_room = nil
local TITLE_HEIGHT = 0
AUTO_CENTER = (GetVariable("auto_center") ~= "0")
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Utility Functions -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Locates the correct path for database files, checking both root and plugin dirs. local function get_db_path(name) local root = GetInfo(60) or "" local plugins = GetInfo(66) or ""
local function fix_path(p) if p == "" then return "" end if p:sub(-1) ~= "\\" and p:sub(-1) ~= "/" then p = p .. "\\" end return p end
local root_path = fix_path(root) .. name local plugin_path = fix_path(plugins) .. name
-- Check root MUSHclient directory first local f = io.open(root_path, "r") if f then local size = f:seek("end") f:close() if size > 0 then return root_path end end
-- Check plugins directory second local f2 = io.open(plugin_path, "r") if f2 then local size = f2:seek("end") f2:close() if size > 0 then return plugin_path end end
return root_path end
-- Initializes the miniwindow using the 'movewindow' library to recall position/size. -- Initializes the miniwindow. -- We use 'movewindow' to create standard drag handlers/hotspots, but we manually -- load/save the position and size to ensure our custom resizes persist correctly. function create_window() -- Initialize movewindow handler helper (ignoring its config for pos/size) -- Using 'false' for the auto-load argument to prevent it from overwriting our manual load movewindow.install(win, miniwin.pos_top_right, miniwin.create_absolute_location, false)
local grid_width = tonumber(GetVariable("width")) or 400 local grid_height = tonumber(GetVariable("height")) or 400
local start_x = tonumber(GetVariable("window_left")) or 0 local start_y = tonumber(GetVariable("window_top")) or 0
print(string.format("Grid Mapper: Loading Window - Pos: %d,%d Size: %dx%d", start_x, start_y, grid_width, grid_height))
-- Basic window validation if grid_width < 50 then grid_width = 400 end if grid_height < 50 then grid_height = 400 end
-- (Offsets of 0,0 are valid, so we don't treat them as 'uninitialized')
-- Update local windowinfo table windowinfo = { window_left = start_x, window_top = start_y, window_mode = miniwin.pos_top_right, -- default fallback window_flags = 2 -- absolute location }
local bg_color = (Theme and Theme.PRIMARY_BODY) or 0x0c0c0c local res = WindowCreate(win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, grid_width, grid_height, windowinfo.create_absolute_location or 12, 2, bg_color)
-- Register the single "background" hotspot that handles all mouse events WindowDeleteHotspot(win, "background") WindowAddHotspot(win, "background", 0, 0, grid_width, grid_height, "", "", "OnMouseDown", "OnMouseCancel", "OnMouseUp", "Drag rooms or the map. Scroll to zoom. Alt-Click or Double-click to speedwalk. Ctrl-Click for Info.", miniwin.cursor_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(win, "background", "OnMouseMove", "OnMouseUp", 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(win, "background", "OnMouseWheel")
-- Make sure to show the window if it was visible if GRID_WINDOW_VISIBLE then WindowShow(win, true) end
return res end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Plugin Initialization -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function OnPluginInstall() create_window()
local main_path = get_db_path("Aardwolf.db") local pos_path = get_db_path("Aardwolf_Grid.db")
print("Grid Mapper: Opening Main DB at " .. main_path) main_db = sqlite3.open(main_path) pos_db = sqlite3.open(pos_path)
-- Ensure our custom position table exists pos_db:exec([[ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS room_positions ( uid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, area TEXT, x REAL, y REAL, z REAL ); ]])
-- NOTE: Do not create a plugin-level known_rooms table here; known rooms are authoritative in main_db.
-- Load terrain colors from the main Aardwolf DB terrain_colours = {} user_terrain_colour = {} if main_db then -- Check which tables exist (environments, terrain) local tables = {} local status = pcall(function() for row in main_db:nrows("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'") do tables[row.name:lower()] = true end end)
if tables["environments"] then local env_count = 0 for row in main_db:nrows("SELECT * FROM environments") do if row.name then terrain_colours [tostring(row.name):lower()] = tonumber (row.color) env_count = env_count + 1 end end print("Grid Mapper: Loaded " .. env_count .. " environment colors.") end
if tables["terrain"] then local user_count = 0 for row in main_db:nrows("SELECT * FROM terrain") do if row.name then user_terrain_colour [tostring(row.name):lower()] = row.color user_count = user_count + 1 end end print("Grid Mapper: Loaded " .. user_count .. " user terrain colors.") end end
load_known_rooms()
-- Apply saved font settings user_font_name = GetVariable("user_font_name") or "Dina" user_font_size = tonumber(GetVariable("user_font_size")) or 8 WindowFont(win, "f", user_font_name, user_font_size) WindowFont(win, "title", user_font_name, user_font_size + 1, true)
local show = (GetVariable("window_visible") ~= "0") GRID_WINDOW_VISIBLE = show WindowShow(win, show)
AUTO_CENTER = (GetVariable("auto_center") ~= "0")
if IsConnected() then Send_GMCP_Packet("request room") end end
function OnPluginSaveState() -- Save Window State Manually to ensure it persists with custom resize SetVariable("width", WindowInfo(win, 3) or 400) SetVariable("height", WindowInfo(win, 4) or 400) SetVariable("window_left", WindowInfo(win, 1) or 0) SetVariable("window_top", WindowInfo(win, 2) or 0)
-- Save Settings SetVariable("user_font_name", user_font_name) SetVariable("user_font_size", user_font_size)
SetVariable("scale", scale) SetVariable("offset_x", offset_x) SetVariable("offset_y", offset_y) SetVariable("window_visible", (GRID_WINDOW_VISIBLE and "1") or "0") SetVariable("auto_center", (AUTO_CENTER and "1") or "0") SetVariable("room_size_factor", room_size_factor)
-- print(string.format("Grid Mapper: Saving State... Size: %dx%d Pos: %d,%d Font: %s %d", -- GetVariable("width"), GetVariable("height"), GetVariable("window_left"), GetVariable("window_top"), -- user_font_name, user_font_size)) -- We are doing manual saving now, so we skip movewindow.save_state to avoid conflicts. end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GMCP / Protocol Handling -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function Send_GMCP_Packet(packet) CallPlugin("3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264", "Send_GMCP_Packet", packet) end
-- Receives GMCP updates (Room Info) from the main Aardwolf MUSHclient plugin. -- This is where we detect room changes, area changes, and new room data. function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) if id == "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264" then -- gmcphandler if text == "room.info" then local res, gmcparg = CallPlugin("3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264", "gmcpval", "room.info") if res == 0 and gmcparg and gmcparg ~= "" then local ok, err = pcall(loadstring("gmcpdata = " .. gmcparg)) if ok then local old_room = current_room local old_area = current_area -- Capture previous area before update current_room = tostring(gmcpdata.num or "") current_area = gmcpdata.zone -- Use GMCP-provided full zone name immediately if available if gmcpdata.zone_name and gmcpdata.zone_name ~= "" then current_area_name = gmcpdata.zone_name end
-- Mark current room as known immediately (in-memory only) known_rooms[current_room] = true -- If we're about to change areas, persist the current area's in-memory rooms/positions into cache if old_area and current_area and current_area ~= old_area and rooms then area_rooms_cache[old_area] = rooms area_positions_cache[old_area] = room_positions end
-- 1. Handle Area Change FIRST -- If we moved to a new area, load its map data immediately. -- This ensures `rooms` and `room_positions` align with the new area. if current_area and current_area ~= old_area then load_area(current_area) auto_center() end
-- 2. Update/Add Room Data -- Now that `rooms` contains the correct area's data, we update or add the current room. if rooms[current_room] then rooms[current_room].terrain = gmcpdata.terrain or rooms[current_room].terrain rooms[current_room].info = gmcpdata.details or gmcpdata.info or rooms[current_room].info rooms[current_room].exits = gmcpdata.exits or rooms[current_room].exits else rooms[current_room] = { uid = current_room, name = gmcpdata.name, area = current_area, terrain = gmcpdata.terrain, info = gmcpdata.details or gmcpdata.info, exits = gmcpdata.exits or {} } end
-- 3. Position the Room -- Only tries to position relative to *current* area's known rooms. -- If we just switched areas, `room_positions` only has new area rooms, -- so we won't accidentally link to the old area. if not room_positions[current_room] then -- Ensure the current room is positioned immediately so it is visible on first entry. local any_pos = false for _ in pairs(room_positions) do any_pos = true break end if not any_pos then -- Fresh area: seed current room at origin room_positions[tostring(current_room)] = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0} save_room_position(current_room) else -- Try to infer from a neighboring room if possible local placed = false local r = rooms[current_room] if r and r.exits then for dir, touid in pairs(r.exits) do local nr = tostring(touid) if room_positions[nr] then local rev = REVERSE_DIRS[dir] if rev and DIR_OFFSETS[rev] then local off = DIR_OFFSETS[rev] local npos = room_positions[nr] room_positions[tostring(current_room)] = {x = npos.x + off.x, y = npos.y + off.y, z = npos.z + (off.z or 0)} save_room_position(current_room) placed = true break end end end end if not placed then fill_unpositioned_rooms() end end end if GRID_WINDOW_VISIBLE then draw_map() end end end end end end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Debug Utilities -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function gridmapper_debug() print("--- Grid Mapper Debug ---") print("Window ID: ", win) print("Current Room: ", current_room or "nil") print("Current Area: ", current_area or "nil") if current_room and rooms[current_room] then print("Current Room Terrain: ", rooms[current_room].terrain or "nil") print("Current Room Info: ", rooms[current_room].info or "nil") end print("Scale: ", scale) print("Room Size Factor: ", room_size_factor) print("Offset: ", offset_x, offset_y) print("Rooms Loaded: ", table.count(rooms)) print("Positions Loaded: ", table.count(room_positions)) print("Main DB Path: ", get_db_path("Aardwolf.db")) print("Terrain Colours Loaded: ", table.count(terrain_colours)) end
-- Schedule a deferred initial area load to avoid race with GMCP mapper -- Deferred initial load and progressive retries removed (DB issue fixed upstream)
function table.count(t) local c = 0 for _ in pairs(t) do c = c + 1 end return c end
-- Refresh the 'known_rooms' cache for determining if an exit stub is unexplored or just distant. function load_known_rooms() known_rooms = {} if not main_db then return end for row in main_db:nrows("SELECT uid FROM rooms") do known_rooms[tostring(row.uid)] = true end end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Area Loading & Layout -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tries to find positions for rooms that are in 'rooms' but not 'room_positions'. -- Uses existing positioned neighbors to infer coordinates. function fill_unpositioned_rooms() local changed = true while changed do changed = false for uid, room in pairs(rooms) do if not room_positions[uid] then -- Check if any neighbor has a position for dir, touid in pairs(room.exits) do local touid_str = tostring(touid) if room_positions[touid_str] then local rdir = REVERSE_DIRS[dir] if rdir then local offset = DIR_OFFSETS[rdir] local neighbor_pos = room_positions[touid_str] local new_pos = { x = neighbor_pos.x + offset.x, y = neighbor_pos.y + offset.y, z = neighbor_pos.z + (offset.z or 0) } room_positions[uid] = new_pos save_room_position(uid) changed = true break -- Found a position for this room, move to next room end end end end end end end
-- Loads all rooms, connections, and coordinates for a given Area UID. -- If no custom positions exist (unvisited area), it triggers a fresh BFS layout. function load_area(area_uid) local DEBUG_MERGE = false local DEBUG_LOAD = true -- If we have a cached copy for this area, reuse it to preserve runtime-updated fields. if area_rooms_cache[area_uid] then rooms = area_rooms_cache[area_uid] room_positions = area_positions_cache[area_uid] or {} else rooms = {} room_positions = {} end
if not main_db then return end
-- 1. Load basic room info (name, terrain, etc.) local stmt = main_db:prepare("SELECT uid, name, area, terrain, info FROM rooms WHERE area = ?") if not stmt then return end stmt:bind_values(area_uid) local count = 0 for row in stmt:nrows() do local ruid = tostring(row.uid) if rooms[ruid] then if DEBUG_MERGE then print(string.format("GridMapper: merging room %s (area %s)", ruid, area_uid)) end -- Merge DB values into existing in-memory room (preserve runtime-updated fields) rooms[ruid].name = row.name or rooms[ruid].name rooms[ruid].area = row.area or rooms[ruid].area rooms[ruid].terrain = row.terrain or rooms[ruid].terrain rooms[ruid].info = row.info or rooms[ruid].info else if DEBUG_MERGE then print(string.format("GridMapper: creating room %s (area %s)", ruid, area_uid)) end rooms[ruid] = { uid = ruid, name = row.name, area = row.area, terrain = row.terrain, info = row.info, exits = {}, cexits = {} } -- load-time debug output removed end count = count + 1 end stmt:finalize() -- load summary and missing-room retry scheduling suppressed local missing = {} for uid, room in pairs(rooms) do if room.area == area_uid and (not room.terrain or room.terrain == "") then table.insert(missing, uid) end end if #missing > 0 then pending_missing_rooms[area_uid] = pending_missing_rooms[area_uid] or {} for _, m in ipairs(missing) do table.insert(pending_missing_rooms[area_uid], m) end if not pending_missing_attempts[area_uid] then pending_missing_attempts[area_uid] = 0 local flags = timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.Replace + timer_flag.Temporary + timer_flag.ActiveWhenClosed + timer_flag.Enabled AddTimer("gm_missing_rooms_retry_150_" .. tostring(area_uid), 0, 0, 0.15, "", flags, "retry_missing_rooms_timer") AddTimer("gm_missing_rooms_retry_500_" .. tostring(area_uid), 0, 0, 0.5, "", flags, "retry_missing_rooms_timer") end end
-- Look up full area name current_area_name = area_uid local stmt_area = main_db:prepare("SELECT name FROM areas WHERE uid = ?") if stmt_area then stmt_area:bind_values(area_uid) -- Use nrows iterator to safely retrieve text values for row in stmt_area:nrows() do if row.name and row.name ~= "" then current_area_name = row.name break end end -- Area name resolved; no debug print in normal operation stmt_area:finalize() end
-- 2. Load Exits (topology) local stmt_exits = main_db:prepare([[ SELECT fromuid, touid, dir FROM exits WHERE fromuid IN (SELECT uid FROM rooms WHERE area = ?) ]]) if stmt_exits then stmt_exits:bind_values(area_uid) for row in stmt_exits:nrows() do if rooms[row.fromuid] then rooms[row.fromuid].exits[row.dir] = row.touid end end stmt_exits:finalize() end
-- 3. Load Custom Exits (cexits) local stmt_cexits = main_db:prepare([[ SELECT roomuid, dir, command FROM cexits WHERE roomuid IN (SELECT uid FROM rooms WHERE area = ?) ]]) if stmt_cexits then stmt_cexits:bind_values(area_uid) local cexit_count = 0 for row in stmt_cexits:nrows() do local ruid = tostring(row.roomuid) if rooms[ruid] then table.insert(rooms[ruid].cexits, {dir = row.dir, command = row.command}) cexit_count = cexit_count + 1 end end stmt_cexits:finalize() print("Grid Mapper: Loaded " .. cexit_count .. " cexits for area " .. area_uid) end
-- 4. Load Custom Coordinates local stmt_pos = pos_db:prepare("SELECT uid, x, y, z FROM room_positions WHERE area = ?") if stmt_pos then stmt_pos:bind_values(area_uid) for row in stmt_pos:nrows() do room_positions[tostring(row.uid)] = {x = row.x, y = row.y, z = row.z} end stmt_pos:finalize() end
-- 5. If no positions loaded, run initial layout local has_positions = false for _ in pairs(room_positions) do has_positions = true break end if not has_positions and current_room and rooms[current_room] then do_bfs_layout(current_room) else fill_unpositioned_rooms() end load_known_rooms() -- Refresh global cache as well -- Schedule a one-shot retry for area name lookup to handle timing races where the DB row may appear shortly after load. if area_uid then -- AddTimer(name, hour, minute, second, "", flags, functionName) -- Use small delay (0.15s) and OneShot + Replace + Temporary + ActiveWhenClosed local flags = timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.Replace + timer_flag.Temporary + timer_flag.ActiveWhenClosed + timer_flag.Enabled -- Unique timer name per area to avoid collisions local tname = "gm_area_name_retry_" .. tostring(area_uid) AddTimer(tname, 0, 0, 0.15, "", flags, "retry_area_name_timer") end end
-- Retry helper: re-query the areas table for a given uid and update the displayed name if it changed. function retry_area_name_lookup(area_uid) if not main_db or not area_uid then return end local stmt_area = main_db:prepare("SELECT name FROM areas WHERE uid = ?") if not stmt_area then return end stmt_area:bind_values(area_uid) for row in stmt_area:nrows() do if row.name and row.name ~= "" then if current_area == area_uid and current_area_name ~= row.name then current_area_name = row.name draw_map() end break end end stmt_area:finalize() end
-- Timer wrapper called by AddTimer (timers call a function name with no args) function retry_area_name_timer() local area = current_area if not area then return end -- Retry timer triggered; no debug print in normal operation -- Ask main GMCP handler for area details which may populate the DB Send_GMCP_Packet("request area") Send_GMCP_Packet("request room") -- Immediate attempt retry_area_name_lookup(area) -- Schedule two follow-up retries in case the DB is populated shortly after local flags = timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.Replace + timer_flag.Temporary + timer_flag.ActiveWhenClosed + timer_flag.Enabled AddTimer("gm_area_name_retry_again_150_" .. tostring(area), 0, 0, 0.15, "", flags, "retry_area_name_timer_helper") AddTimer("gm_area_name_retry_again_500_" .. tostring(area), 0, 0, 0.5, "", flags, "retry_area_name_timer_helper") end
function retry_area_name_timer_helper() retry_area_name_lookup(current_area) end
-- Timer wrapper to retry loading missing room data for an area function retry_missing_rooms_timer() local area = current_area if not area then return end pending_missing_attempts[area] = (pending_missing_attempts[area] or 0) + 1 if pending_missing_attempts[area] > 12 then -- Give up after some attempts pending_missing_attempts[area] = nil pending_missing_rooms[area] = nil return end -- Query DB for the specific missing room UIDs and update in-memory rooms when available local pend = pending_missing_rooms[area] if not pend or #pend == 0 then pending_missing_rooms[area] = nil pending_missing_attempts[area] = nil return end -- Build a param list to query multiple UIDs safely local found_any = false for i = #pend, 1, -1 do local uid = pend[i] if main_db then local stmt = main_db:prepare("SELECT terrain, info FROM rooms WHERE uid = ? LIMIT 1") if stmt then stmt:bind_values(uid) for row in stmt:nrows() do if row.terrain and row.terrain ~= "" then if rooms[uid] then rooms[uid].terrain = row.terrain end if row.info and row.info ~= "" then if rooms[uid] then rooms[uid].info = row.info end end found_any = true table.remove(pend, i) end end stmt:finalize() end end end if found_any then draw_map() end -- If there are still pending rooms, print their current DB rows for diagnostics if pending_missing_rooms[area] and #pending_missing_rooms[area] > 0 then for _, uid in ipairs(pending_missing_rooms[area]) do if main_db then local stmt2 = main_db:prepare("SELECT uid, name, terrain, info FROM rooms WHERE uid = ? LIMIT 1") if stmt2 then stmt2:bind_values(uid) for row in stmt2:nrows() do -- diagnostic removed end stmt2:finalize() else -- diagnostic removed end else -- diagnostic removed end end end -- Re-schedule another retry if there are still pending rooms if pending_missing_rooms[area] and #pending_missing_rooms[area] > 0 then local flags = timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.Replace + timer_flag.Temporary + timer_flag.ActiveWhenClosed + timer_flag.Enabled AddTimer("gm_missing_rooms_retry_again_" .. tostring(area) .. "_" .. tostring(pending_missing_attempts[area]), 0, 0, 0.25, "", flags, "retry_missing_rooms_timer") else pending_missing_attempts[area] = nil pending_missing_rooms[area] = nil end end
-- Assigns integer coordinates to rooms starting from a seed room (0,0,0). function do_bfs_layout(start_uid) local start_uid_str = tostring(start_uid) local queue = {{uid = start_uid_str, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0}} room_positions[start_uid_str] = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0} local visited = {[start_uid_str] = true} local head = 1 -- DIR_OFFSETS is now global while head <= #queue do local curr = queue[head] head = head + 1 local room = rooms[curr.uid] if room then for dir, touid in pairs(room.exits) do local touid_str = tostring(touid) if rooms[touid_str] and not visited[touid_str] then local off = DIR_OFFSETS[dir] or {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0} local next_pos = {x = curr.x + off.x, y = curr.y + off.y, z = curr.z + (off.z or 0)} room_positions[touid_str] = next_pos visited[touid_str] = true table.insert(queue, {uid = touid_str, x = next_pos.x, y = next_pos.y, z = next_pos.z}) end end end end save_all_positions() end
function save_all_positions() pos_db:exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION") local stmt = pos_db:prepare("REPLACE INTO room_positions (uid, area, x, y, z) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)") for uid, pos in pairs(room_positions) do stmt:bind_values(uid, current_area, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z) stmt:step() stmt:reset() end stmt:finalize() pos_db:exec("COMMIT") end
function save_room_position(uid) local pos = room_positions[uid] if not pos then return end local stmt = pos_db:prepare("REPLACE INTO room_positions (uid, area, x, y, z) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)") stmt:bind_values(uid, current_area, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z) stmt:step() stmt:finalize() end

-- If there was any non-door cexit, draw the teal dot if has_special_cexit then local dot_size = math.max(2, math.floor(room_size / 4)) local dot_color = 0x808000 -- Teal WindowRectOp(win, 2, right - dot_size - 1, top + 1, right - 1, top + dot_size + 1, dot_color) end end

function resize_mouse_down(flags, hotspot_id) start_resize_x, start_resize_y = WindowInfo(win, 17), WindowInfo(win, 18) end function resize_move_callback() local posx, posy = WindowInfo(win, 17), WindowInfo(win, 18) local width, height = math.max(100, WindowInfo(win, 3) + posx - start_resize_x), math.max(100, WindowInfo(win, 4) + posy - start_resize_y) start_resize_x, start_resize_y = posx, posy WindowResize(win, width, height, (Theme and Theme.PRIMARY_BODY) or 0x0c0c0c) draw_map() end -- Called when the resize drag interaction finishes. function resize_release_callback() OnPluginSaveState() end function OnMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) local x, y = WindowInfo(win, 14), WindowInfo(win, 15) last_mouse_x, last_mouse_y = x, y if dragging_room or dragging_map then return end

local is_shift = bit.band(flags, SHIFT) ~= 0 if is_shift then is_selecting = true selection_start_x, selection_start_y = x, y selection_end_x, selection_end_y = x, y draw_map() return end

-- Shift the current room (or selected rooms) by one grid unit in the given direction. -- Accepts short or long directions, e.g. 'n'|'north', 's'|'south', 'e'|'east', 'w'|'west', -- 'u'|'up', 'd'|'down'. Also accepts bare single-letter like 'd' which may be ambiguous with 'down'; -- we prefer matching full words first and fall back to single-letter mapping. function gridmapper_shift(dir_raw) if not dir_raw or dir_raw == "" then print("Grid Mapper: Usage: gridmapper shift <direction>") return end local d = tostring(dir_raw):lower() -- Reuse global DIR_OFFSETS where possible. Provide synonyms for long words. local synonyms = { north = 'n', south = 's', east = 'e', west = 'w', northeast = 'ne', northwest = 'nw', southeast = 'se', southwest = 'sw', up = 'u', down = 'd' } -- Normalize common abbreviations (allow 'north' or 'n') local key = synonyms[d] or d -- If user passed full-word like 'down' or single-letter 'd', key should resolve. -- Ensure we prefer exact keys in DIR_OFFSETS; accept single-letter defaults as-is. local delta = DIR_OFFSETS[key] -- If still not found, try taking first char (e.g., user typed 'down' -> 'd') if not delta and #d > 1 then local first = d:sub(1,1) delta = DIR_OFFSETS[first] end if not delta then print("Grid Mapper: Unknown direction '" .. dir_raw .. "'. Use n/s/e/w/u/d or north/south/etc.") return end
-- Apply to selected rooms if any, otherwise to current_room local targets = {} if next(selected_rooms) then for uid in pairs(selected_rooms) do table.insert(targets, uid) end elseif current_room then table.insert(targets, tostring(current_room)) else print("Grid Mapper: No current room selected to shift.") return end
for _, uid in ipairs(targets) do if not room_positions[uid] then room_positions[uid] = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0} end local pos = room_positions[uid] pos.x = (pos.x or 0) + (delta.x or 0) pos.y = (pos.y or 0) + (delta.y or 0) pos.z = (pos.z or 0) + (delta.z or 0) -- Snap to half-grid to keep consistency with dragging behavior (plugin uses 0.5 steps) pos.x = math.floor(pos.x * 2 + 0.5) / 2 pos.y = math.floor(pos.y * 2 + 0.5) / 2 save_room_position(uid) end
auto_center() draw_map() print("Grid Mapper: Shifted " .. #targets .. " room(s) " .. dir_raw) end
